question: Why were best-performing Shorts showing Private on mobile Studio?
answer: Not intentional. Desktop Studio + anonymous playabilityStatus=OK show the view-bearing Last Star keepers as Public. Mobile padlocks were stale or mid-edit. Mystery punch work left only a 0-view filename draft private — it did not keep these performers private.
verification_method: Studio visibility widget + anonymous ytInitialPlayerResponse.playabilityStatus (oembed 401 alone is NOT proof of private — embedding can fail while watch works)
